state.seed_assertion: Examples of processing using innovative technology include artificial intelligence, machine learning and deep learning; connected and autonomous vehicles; intelligent transport systems; smart technologies including wearables; market research involving neuro-measurement; and some internet of things applications.

sentences.1: Examples of processing using innovative technology include artificial intelligence, machine learning and deep learning;
sentences.6: and some internet of things applications.
sentences.7: Examples of processing using innovative technology include: artificial intelligence, machine learning and deep learning;
sentences.9: Processing involving the use of innovative technologies, or the novel application of existing technologies including AI, requires a DPIA when combined with any of the criteria from the European guidelines according to the ICO list.
sentences.10: Innovative technology: processing involving the use of innovative technologies, or the novel application of existing technologies (including AI).
sentences.11: A DPIA must be conducted if one plans to use innovative technology in combination with any of the criteria in the European guidelines.
sentences.12: Recital 91 of the UK GDPR specifies that innovative technology concerns new developments in technological knowledge in the world at large, rather than technology that is new to the particular controller.
